description:
relay_client.rs appends '
.
' as the SMTP DATA terminator (line 706). nntp_dot_stuff() always appends '
' after the last line of the body (for all non-empty inputs). The double '
' before the dot means the receiving MTA sees an extra blank line at the end of every relayed message body.

Concrete example: article b'Hello
' -> nntp_dot_stuff -> b'Hello
' -> relay appends '
.
' -> wire: 'Hello

.
'. Server strips terminator and delivers body as 'Hello

' (trailing blank line).

Fix options:
1. Change relay terminator from '
.
' to '.
' (since nntp_dot_stuff guarantees trailing 
 for non-empty input). Guard empty-body case separately.
2. Change nntp_dot_stuff to not append trailing 
 to the last line, keep relay terminator as '
.
'.

RFC 5321 §4.5.2: the CRLF before the dot-line is required to terminate the last body line, not to insert a blank line.

Scope: crates/smtp/src/relay_client.rs line 706 and crates/core/src/util.rs fn nntp_dot_stuff.
notes: Found in review iteration 5. Parent epic: stoa-2xeks.
title: P2: relay DATA terminator adds spurious trailing blank line
